releases.name: v0.2.0 — Agent-OS Vision
releases.body:
## Agent-OS Vision — Full Platform Rebuild

17 pillars, 342 issues, 524 commits. Fulcrum is now a complete Agent OS platform.

### Highlights

- **Project Management** — Kanban boards, sprints, burndown charts, custom fields
- **Document Editor** — TipTap rich text, version history, comments, templates
- **Agent Orchestration** — Symphony dispatch, sandboxed runs, retry/stall recovery
- **Memory & Context** — Heuristic extraction, BM25 retrieval, context assembly
- **Search** — Full-text search with facets, saved searches, click telemetry
- **Notifications** — Rule engine, inbox, audit log, quiet hours, webhooks
- **Three Surfaces** — Web (SvelteKit), CLI (Bun), TUI (44 screens)
- **25+ Feature Flags** — i18n, experiments, PWA, Tauri desktop, real-time collab, and more

### Architecture

- **Local-first** with PGlite (embedded Postgres) — no external DB needed
- **SaaS-ready** schema with org_id scoping from day one
- **tRPC** shared router across all three surfaces
- **Better-Auth** for production auth (dev mode skips login)

### What's Gated (shipped but OFF by default)

i18n, semantic search, experiments/A/B testing, PWA offline, Tauri desktop,
real-time collaboration, SaaS auth, public REST API, CSV/Linear/Jira/Plane imports,
remote telemetry, error reporting, vault integration, scheduled backups, LLM narratives

### Known Gaps

- 297 pre-existing test failures (migration drift, browser/Tiptap tests without DOM)
- `docs.tree` and `docs.move` tRPC procedures not yet implemented
- Backup runner produces JSON manifest (not full pg_dump)
- See `docs/TEST-GAPS.md` for 94 documented integration/e2e test gaps
